name: reviso
description: Local, pre-PR code review: /review-grade findings plus an anti-slop lens, report-only, on your own subscription.

interface.shortDescription: Review changes before opening a pull request
interface.longDescription: Report-only correctness and style reviews for local Git changes. Includes a deeper audit with independent review roles.
defaultPrompt: Use $reviso review to review my changes.
Use $reviso style to check style and duplication.
Use $reviso audit for a deeper review.
